description: How it works and the proof figure (plan.md steps 7-8; marketing-site tasks 35-36). Depends on FEAT-001 (getHowData for 4663, proofSaidLine, roles.ts, KeypadPicture rings, the role CSS and SiteMotion's step observer). How becomes one small app screen (HowScreen) that the three steps act on: sticky on desktop and driven only by A8 step sync, a data-play stage per step card under 1024px. The proof figure becomes ProofCheck: one stable layout where each word keeps its row, digit lines arrive, a column box sweeps, wafer's differing digit is boxed with an x, the chips turn real, then the closing lines.
steps: Step 7 of plan.md: new packages/web/components/site/pictures/HowScreen.tsx ({ how: HowData; part: 'all' | 1 | 2 | 3 }) per design.md 4.1: the well (texts from how.typing via the TYPING tuple mapped with its index; digits '4', '4 6', '4 6 6', '4 6 6 3'), 'Press a key to start' in label type as role('out', 0), rings on keys 4 (0-1), 6 (1-2), 6 (2-3, late), 3 (3-4) through KeypadPicture rings, rows (div.nl-candidate, ranks 1-3, role('rise', 0|1|2), rendered only when how.sentences.length), the chosen marker overlays (row 1 ring 3-5, row how.chosen mark k5), the step-2 out-wrapper u5 around step 1's 'Good' and the sentence-cased chosen word in k5, Speak/Speaking in one .site-cell (ring on Speak 0-1, 'Speak' out u1, 'Speaking' in k1); every animated part carries data-s 1-3; drawn Speak is nl-btn--secondary. Root class site-drawing, aria-hidden.

Rewrite packages/web/components/site/sections/How.tsx: step 1 text from content.md §2 ('Keys 2 to 9 carry the letters. G, H and I share key 4, so "home" is 4 6 6 3, and so is "good". No tapping a key three times and no code to learn. 0 is space.'); .site-how__picture keeps data-reveal and holds <HowScreen part="all" /> with NO data-play; each step li keeps data-reveal and --reveal-i and gets div.site-stage.site-how__stage (aria-hidden) whose drawing is a data-play root with play('type'), play('sweep'), play('frame') for steps 1-3; the step label becomes a .site-cell with the plain span and .site-step__key (both in the aria-hidden label).

site.css for How: under 1024px .site-how__picture display none, stage heights calc(var(--space-24) * 4 + var(--space-8)) / calc(var(--space-24) * 3) / calc(var(--space-24) + var(--space-16)), tablet two-column cards from 600px, the wrapping stage well; from 1024px --site-how-h, block-size, sticky top var(--space-12), the (min-width: 1024px) and (max-height: 679px) top var(--space-4) rule, .site-how__steps gap 24svh and padding-block max(12svh, calc(var(--site-how-h) - 50svh)) 36svh, drop min-height: 40svh, the .site-how__step::after outline and .site-step__key layer; in the motion block the per-data-s --play-step, the not-reached contexts requiring data-how-live and the play contexts per data-how-play, the outline/label transition over motion-state. Remove the How scroll timeline rules (timeline-scope: --site-how, view-timeline: --site-how, the .site-frames--how animation-timeline rule) and HowFrames from Pictures.tsx; keep the short-landscape block last.

Tests for step 7: site.test.tsx drop the '#how .site-frames--how' line in MS-7.4, MS-10.8 pad count 5 -> 4, add 'MS-8.12 the desktop How picture has no data-play and the per-step stages each have one' and 'MS-7.3 a repeated key press is two rings, the second late'; site-css.test.ts drop the two --site-how expectations in the MS-8.5 case, add 'MS-8.12 How parts take --play-step from their data-s and the not-reached rules need data-how-live' and 'MS-8.12 the How steps' top padding uses --site-how-h from 1024px'. Tick task 35 / 35.1.

Step 8 of plan.md: ProofFrames -> ProofCheck in packages/web/components/site/Pictures.tsx per design.md 4.2 with tuple tables SWEEP [[4,5],[5,6],[6,7],[7,8],[8,9]], DIGIT_LINE [1,2,3], CHIP [9,10,11]: figcaption with span.nl-sr-only 'Your keys: {proof.keys}' plus aria-hidden label and .site-proof__digits grid with 5 sweep boxes; ul.site-proof__rows, one li per word: chip .site-cell (real ProofChip role('in', CHIP[row]) and aria-hidden nl-chip--typing chip role('out', CHIP[row])), aria-hidden letters/digits grid whose digit line is role('rise', DIGIT_LINE[row]) with 5 .site-proof__box spans role('ring', ...SWEEP[c]), wafer's .site-digit--diff box and x icon role('mark', SWEEP[proof.reject.diffAt][0]); p.site-proof__said (proofSaidLine) and the For example line, both role('in', 12), outside aria-hidden. packages/web/components/site/sections/Proof.tsx: figure.site-proof keeps data-reveal, adds data-play and play('sweep'), drops the plain figcaption. Remove the proof's frame labels and its own frame CSS (.site-frames--proof, .site-checks*, .site-frame__label if unused); add the proof grid CSS (--proof-col var(--space-8), gap var(--space-2), grid-auto-rows var(--space-6)).

Tests for step 8: in site.test.tsx rewrite MS-7.2 (stages, the How picture, .site-drawing and .site-pad are inside aria-hidden; in the proof figure only the sr-only caption, the real ProofChips and the two closing lines are outside aria-hidden; nothing focusable), drop the proof line of MS-7.4, rewrite MS-9.3 for the new structure, add 'MS-7.9 the proof figure keeps its accessible text, adds the closing line and has no frame labels' and 'MS-7.9 every digit line holds 5 sweep boxes and no box sits outside a digit line'. Tick task 36 / 36.1.
Add a docs/KIRO_LOG.md row for this FEAT with `node scripts/kiro-log.mjs add` (credits blank).
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm -F @ninth/web test --run`: every test passes except possibly site.test.tsx MS-4.1 (now failing only on box-drawing strings that FEAT-003 adds, not on the How step 1 text)
the new MS-8.12, MS-7.3 and MS-7.9 cases named in tasks 35.1 and 36.1 pass
site.css has no timeline-scope or --site-how timeline left; .site-how__picture has no data-play attribute in the rendered page
MS-11.6 markup test still passes (at most 15 KB gzip); if not, stop and send_message severity 'warning'
`node scripts/tm-lint.mjs` on every changed file exits 0; tasks.md rows 35-36 ticked; nothing committed
findings: MARKUP: MS-11.6 now 7,705 bytes gzip (was 7,149; limit 15,360); recorded in the test comment. TESTS: typecheck passes; web 370 of 371 pass; the only failure is MS-4.1, now on 'Nothing yet.' (content.md §4, a FEAT-003 drawing string): §0-§3, including the new How step 1 text and the proof's closing line, pass. site.test.tsx: MS-7.4 renamed 'MS-7.4 the multi-frame drawings have 4 and 2 frames, and the still drawings are present' (How and proof frame counts dropped; FEAT-003 replaces the rest); MS-7.2 rewritten and renamed 'MS-7.2 drawings, stages and the How picture are aria-hidden; the proof figure exposes only its caption, chips and closing lines; nothing focusable' (it scans .site-drawing, .site-pad, .site-frames, .site-stage, .site-how__picture > *); MS-9.3 renamed '... the differing digit is boxed with an x'; MS-10.8 pad count 4; new cases 'MS-7.9 the proof figure keeps its accessible text, adds the closing line and has no frame labels', 'MS-7.9 every digit line holds 5 sweep boxes and no box sits outside a digit line', 'MS-8.12 the desktop How picture has no data-play and the per-step stages each have one', 'MS-7.3 a repeated key press is two rings, the second late'. jsdom (nwsapi) selectors in tests avoid :is(). site-css.test.ts: MS-8.5 lost its two --site-how lines; new 'MS-8.12 How parts take --play-step from their data-s and the not-reached rules need data-how-live' (expects exactly 3 not-reached rules and 6 play rules of 3 parts each in the motion block's 1024px blocks) and "MS-8.12 the How steps' top padding uses --site-how-h from 1024px" (also checks the 3 stage heights, .site-how__picture { display: none; } at top level, no timeline-scope/--site-how/site-frames--how left). MEASURED on the dev server: at 320 x 640 the stages are 240 wide; stage 1 content 406 of 416 (well 82 + keypad 312), stage 2 278 of 288 after the row fix (well 82 + rows 3 x 56 + gaps), stage 3 150 of 160; no horizontal overflow. The proof figure is 680px tall at 320 and 654px at 1024 (design estimated about 520; taller than 70% of most viewports, so it plays through the top-line observer). At 1024 x 768 the How picture is 387 x 616 with content 602 (well 82, rows 184, keypad 312); the steps' top padding is 232px. Finished states and the step-3 outline + key label checked by screenshot. No height was raised. CHANGES OUTSIDE THE PLAN TEXT: KeyRing gained an optional s?: '1'|'2'|'3' rendered as data-s on div.site-key-ring, so the key rings take part in the picture's per-step rules. The drawn rows need .site-cand { min-height: var(--target-min); padding-block: calc(var(--space-2) - var(--line-width)); } (nl-candidate's 72px min and 2px border otherwise made them 60px). In the stages the well uses var(--surface) (the stage is surface-sunken). CLASS NAMES: HowScreen root div.site-drawing.site-how-screen (+ data-play and site-play--type|sweep|frame for parts 1-3); well = .site-well[.site-well--row] > .site-well__body > (.site-cell.site-well__text, .site-cell.site-well__keys) + drawn Speak; hint .site-well__hint; Speak ring div.site-press-ring (shares the .site-key-ring rule: '.site-press-ring, .site-key-ring {'); rows div.nl-candidate.site-cand with overlay div.site-cand__mark (check icon); step label span.site-step.site-cell > (span, span.site-step__key); stages div.site-stage.site-how__stage, heights by .site-how__step:nth-child(N) .site-how__stage. Proof: figcaption.site-proof__keys > (span.nl-sr-only, span.site-proof__spell[aria-hidden] > (.site-proof__label, .site-proof__digits)); ul.site-proof__rows > li.site-proof__row > (div.site-cell.site-proof__chip, div.site-proof__spell[aria-hidden] > (.site-proof__letters, .site-proof__digits)); digit spans .site-digit (diff one also .site-digit--diff holding span.site-digit__box), 5 span.site-proof__box per line, span.site-digit__x (row 2, inline gridColumn); p.site-proof__said, p.site-proof__example. Digit and box columns come from nth-child rules on .site-proof__digits. REMOVED: HowFrames, ProofFrames, Digits from Pictures.tsx; CSS .site-frame__label, .site-pressed, .site-cand--chosen, .site-frames--proof, .site-chips, .site-checks*, .site-code, the old .site-proof__keys mono rule, the How timeline rules in @supports, .site-how__step min-height 40svh. The shared .site-frame* rules and site-frame-* keyframes stay (scan and Show still use them). CSS PLACEMENT: new top-level How and proof rules sit where the round-1 How/proof drawing rules were; a new '@media (min-width: 600px) and (max-width: 1023px)' block (tablet two-column step cards) follows the 648px block; '@media (min-width: 1024px) and (max-height: 679px)' follows the 1024px block; the How A8 rules are one '@media (min-width: 1024px)' block inside the motion block, after the site-rise keyframes; the short-landscape block is still last.
